analysis: The trial executed successfully but reduced host validation macro HR@10 from 0.5375 to 0.5325 (−0.0050). Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.585 (−0.010), Industrial_and_Scientific 0.555 (unchanged), Electronics 0.430 (−0.005), CDs_and_Vinyl 0.560 (−0.005). Fixed recency pooling did not improve the uniform-preference reference in this controlled trial; these results do not establish why. Retain uniform pooling as the stronger observed configuration. Allocated GPU time: 1,140.26 seconds.
code_summary: SASRec retains its two-block Transformer, 64-dimensional embeddings, item bias, projected and normalized preference branch, and feature-wise sigmoid gate initialized with zero weights and −2 bias. Only preference pooling changes: a causal exponential mean with a fixed ten-observed-interaction half-life, float32 accumulation, and padding that neither contributes nor advances decay. Training retains uniform sampled-softmax loss with 64 negatives and existing optimization and checkpoint selection. Metadata and generated predictor reconstruct the same architecture with strict checkpoint loading and routing across all four datasets. Diagnostics cover pooling semantics, causality, gradients, and predictor score agreement.
